EU Framework Proposal on Candidate Assessment

Instead of complaining about unpaid candidate work, I drafted a 43-page EU-level framework, and coordinated its distribution across 24 EU institutions, labour bodies, social partners and research organisations. The point was to move from “this is broken” to a proposal, and put it in front of organisations able to act on it.

Full proposal:
